configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.description: linux_compile.sh's switches, which every Linux profile shares: OpenAL rather than FMOD, no GTK dialogs, the bundled JPEG.

configurePresets.name: linux-desktop
configurePresets.description: The client players download: GL beside the Vulkan backend, online play, accounts and voice chat.

configurePresets.name: linux-server
configurePresets.description: A headless server: no sound, GL or GTK (SERVERONLY sets them).

configurePresets.name: linux-offline
configurePresets.description: The client without the parts that need a service: no accounts (OpenSSL), voice chat or crash reporting.

configurePresets.name: linux-nogl-vulkan
configurePresets.description: The client with no desktop GL at all, drawing only through the Vulkan backend.

configurePresets.name: web
configurePresets.displayName: Browser: Emscripten, the backend on WebGPU, offline
configurePresets.description: web_compile.sh's build: no desktop GL, no native-only libraries, no accounts or voice chat. Needs EMSDK and IMPORT_EXECUTABLES (a native build's host tools).
